meta.title: Our Robotics & Programming Courses
meta.description: Our curriculum is pedagogically structured to accompany the cognitive development of each student.

title: Courses Adapted by Age
subtitle: Our curriculum is pedagogically structured to accompany the cognitive development of each student.

kinder.title: Programs for Kinder
kinder.description: For early learners starting to explore technology and basic structures.

courses.title: Mini Builders
courses.description: A playful introduction to building and basic mechanics for our youngest learners.

courses.title: Mini Gamers
courses.description: Learn basic logical steps and direction control through fun and simple gameplay coding.

kids.title: Programs for Kids
kids.desc: For curious minds taking their first steps in technology and logic.

courses.title: Little Creators
courses.description: In this workshop, kids learn about the fundamental bases of electronics, robotics, and programming. They will learn by creating small robots that they will program to achieve their goals. The complete course is structured in several workshops of 2 weeks each, so that each child can do it at their own pace.

courses.title: Little Coders
courses.description: In this workshop, kids learn about the fundamental concepts of programming, with simple and guided exercises, then move on to develop their own animations and finally video games using the programming elements learned.

courses.title: Events
courses.description: A one-and-a-half-hour workshop designed as a first technological approach for events and birthday parties. A unique experience that invites kids to awaken curiosity about technology.

teens.title: Programs for Teens
teens.desc: Real programming and robotics challenges for the creators of tomorrow.

courses.title: Young Automators
courses.description: In this workshop, teens will learn the fundamentals of automation and industrial control, using the fundamental concepts of robotics to solve real-world problems.

courses.title: Young Developers
courses.description: In this course, teens will learn to work with industrial programming languages, such as Python and JavaScript, creating systems with graphical web interfaces and database connections.

courses.title: College Preparation
courses.description: If you are thinking of entering college in an engineering or technology career, we help you prepare for admission exams.

adults.title: Programs for Adults
adults.desc: Career change, automation, and industry-leading technologies.

courses.title: Software Initiation
courses.description: A series of workshops that will take you to program from scratch, focusing on the fundamental concepts of software development.

courses.title: Specific Training Workshops
courses.description: Geared towards students and professionals who need to learn a specific technology. These workshops will allow you to learn the theoretical and practical concepts behind each tool or methodology and put them into practice in your classes or work.

courses.title: Corporate Training
courses.description: We build tailored programs for companies, combining workshops, events, and technological team-building activities to boost team training.
